statement: The record lists a buy of 400000 ACME shares (claimed as within limit), which exceeds the 50000-share fund limit, so the order is not submitted.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the 400,000 quantity "exceeds the 50000-share fund limit, so the order is not submitted," directly contradicting the record's "within the limit" claim.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
